cd /app/output && python3 -c "
# Validate all navigation links work between pages
import re
from pathlib import Path

pages = {
    'index.html': ['chart.html', 'ideas.html', 'markets.html', 'brokers.html'],
    'chart.html': ['index.html', 'ideas.html', 'markets.html', 'brokers.html'],
    'ideas.html': ['index.html', 'markets.html', 'brokers.html', 'chart.html'],
    'markets.html': ['index.html', 'ideas.html', 'brokers.html', 'chart.html'],
    'brokers.html': ['index.html', 'markets.html', 'ideas.html', 'chart.html'],
}

for page, expected in pages.items():
    content = Path(page).read_text()
    missing = [e for e in expected if e not in content]
    if missing:
        print(f'{page}: missing links to {missing}')
    else:
        print(f'{page}: all links OK')

# Check SEO
for page in pages:
    content = Path(page).read_text()
    has_title = '<title>' in content
    has_desc = 'name=\"description\"' in content
    has_canonical = 'rel=\"canonical\"' in content
    has_og = 'property=\"og:' in content
    has_twitter = 'property=\"twitter:' in content
    print(f'{page} SEO: title={has_title} desc={has_desc} canonical={has_canonical} og={has_og} twitter={has_twitter}')
"

steps.message:
The **ChartPulse** financial dashboard has been built and output to `/app/output/`. Here's a summary of what was created:

### Files Output
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Home page — hero, market summary tabs, community ideas, indicators, top stories, trending stocks |
| `chart.html` | Interactive chart workspace — candlestick chart, watchlist accordion sidebar, stock detail panel with key stats & financials |
| `ideas.html` | Community trading ideas feed — filterable by Popular/Editors' picks, video toggle, pagination |
| `markets.html` | All markets overview — indices, stocks, crypto, futures, forex, bonds (with yield curve), earnings calendar |
| `brokers.html` | Broker listings — category tabs, rating sort, stats banner |
| `css/styles.css` | Complete dark-mode design system with tokens, components, and responsive breakpoints |
| `js/app.js` | Tab switching, accordion toggles, candlestick chart rendering, sparkline generation, mobile menu |
| `robots.txt` | SEO robots file |
| `sitemap.xml` | SEO sitemap with all 5 pages |

### Key Features Implemented
- **Dark-mode first** design with `#0F0F0F` background and `#2962FF` accent blue
- **Data accuracy** — all prices, percentages, and metrics match `source_brief.md` exactly
- **Tab-driven interactivity** on every page (market categories, idea feeds, broker filters, trading sessions, chart timeframes)
- **Watchlist accordion** with expand/collapse on the chart page
- **Candlestick chart** with interactive timeframe toggles (1D through All)
- **Sparkline charts** throughout for visual price trends
- **Responsive design** with mobile navigation
- **Full SEO meta tags** (title, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter Cards) + JSON-LD structured data on homepage + `robots.txt` + `sitemap.xml` per the `seo-local-business` skill workflow
- **Inter-page navigation** fully wired across all 5 pages
